summary: First-finish smoke test for DHL Horas Extras. Backend (auth, requests, approvals, users) and frontend (login, gestor create request, gerencia approval queue) all functional against public URL.
passed: POST /api/auth/login gestor -> 200 with user object; httpOnly cookies set
POST /api/auth/logout -> 200 and returns Set-Cookie access_token/refresh_token with Max-Age=0
Gestor POST /api/requests -> 200 with numero, status=Pendente, gestor_id, gestor_nome
Gerência GET /api/requests and ?status=Pendente -> 200 with pending list
Frontend login page loads and demo-gestor-btn prefills; submit redirects to /gestor
Nova Solicitação form submits successfully and redirects to /gestor/minhas with 'Solicitação enviada com sucesso!' toast
Minhas Solicitações table shows own requests with status badges (Pendente/Aprovada/Rejeitada)
Gerência login redirects to /gerencia dashboard with stat cards
Aprovações page lists pending request cards with Analisar buttons (2 cards visible)
notes: Console 401s during /auth/me pre-login are expected. Auth cookies confirmed via curl. Backend request schema uses field 'colaborador' (not 'colaborador_nome') - frontend already uses correct field.
